rationale: Because Clarence Thomas is the senior justice in the majority and the conference shows a strong home-threshold/probable-cause framing, he is most likely to keep the opinion and write it, with Kagan/Barrett as plausible assignees to harmonize Olson with Brigham City/Fisher. Separate writings are most likely from the Chief Justice (and possibly Alito) to preserve the “objectively reasonable basis” formulation, and from one or more majority justices to emphasize either originalist home-primacy limits (Thomas/Gorsuch) or anti-pretext/pragmatic constraints (Sotomayor/Jackson).
